entries.title: Global Digital Library Hindi CC BY collection — Class 1

rights.verifiedBy: Global Digital Library catalogue and cached per-book attribution review
rights.basis: Each accepted source record is explicitly CC BY 4.0; damaged source 6161 excluded.

source.attribution: Per-book author, translator, illustrator and publisher credits are retained in each document source record.
source.provenance: 23 of the 92 unique source documents reconstructed from 124 clean cached official GDL text and attribution records (duplicate bodies and damaged source 6161 excluded), placed on Class 1 by measured difficulty (scripts/prepare-hi-gdl-collection.mts).
